package.name: go2_real_planner
package.description:
Real-robot launch wrapper around a_star_mpc_planner.
Spawns the four planner nodes (odom_to_pose, a_star, mpc, setpoint_to_cmd_vel, nav_graph) and selects between a bundled hand-tuned baseline and a bundled BO-tuned parameter set, or accepts an arbitrary YAML at launch time (e.g. fresh output from tuning/bayesian_mpc_tuner.py).
